summary: Frontend regression verification for the visual-edits/i18n <option> hydration fix. Navigated /, /dashboard, /advisor, /calculator, /market in both EN and HI. No console errors, no page errors, no 'span cannot be a child of option' hydration warnings observed on any route. Placeholders and dynamic labels in <select> elements render correctly in both locales.

issues: Non-blocking Recharts warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart container renders before layout has size. Cosmetic warning only, not related to this fix.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct and minimal: pre-resolving i18n strings into local vars (statePlaceholder/districtPlaceholder in Advisor, stageOptions in Calculator, allLabel in Market) prevents the Babel visual-edits plugin from wrapping them in <span data-ve-dynamic>, which was the source of the hydration error inside <option>. No side effects observed.
Consider muting the Recharts width/height warnings on /advisor and /calculator by giving the ResponsiveContainer a min-height or waiting for parent layout — not part of this task.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified in EN and HI: /advisor state placeholder = '— State —' / '— राज्य —'; /calculator stage options render EN ['Seedling','Vegetative','Flowering','Fruiting'] and HI ['बीज','वानस्पतिक','पुष्पन','फल']; /market region 'All'/'सभी' render correctly. Zero console errors and zero pageerror events on all 5 tested routes. Hydration error 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' no longer appears. Backend was intentionally not retested (per request; covered by iterations 1-3).
